item.title: Manteca teen center seeks volunteer music instructors
item.description: Volunteers that play drums, piano, or guitar, can dance, or know drama are being sought to help make a difference in a teen’s life.

item.title: Father-daughter dance in Manteca set for Feb. 7
item.description: The Manteca Recreation & Community Services Father-Daughter Dance is Saturday, Feb. 7.

item.title: Lathrop Police will establish its own tow rotation program
item.description: When the Lathrop Police Department was first established in 2022, the City of Ripon was contracted to provide dispatch duties that also included towing services as needed.

item.title: Growing Turul WPA shows well in California Super League
item.description: What a difference a year has made for the Turul Water Polo Academy. Formerly the Ripon Renegades, the club has seen enough growth since the rebrand that it has had to expand to practice facilities out of the area to accommodate its young athletes.

item.title: CHARLES MAPANAO, River Islands basketball
item.description: The senior shooting guard and the rest of the Riptide are heating up at the right time. They entered this week riding a six-game winning streak, which includes non-league opponents from the area such as defending Trans Valley League champion Ripon Christian.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Lathrop closing in on girls basketball, boys soccer WAC titles
item.description: There are still six games remaining on Lathrop’s girls basketball schedule, but the Spartans took a big step toward the Western Athletic Conference title after routing defending champ Pacheco on the road Tuesday, 58-29.

item.title: Gonzalez nets 2nd-half hat trick in Sierra’s needed win at Manteca
item.description: The Sierra High School Timberwolves got a second-half hat trick from striker Jose Gonzalez on Tuesday night to propel them over a pesky Manteca Buffaloes side 3-2 and stay within a game of first-place East Union with just three league games remaining.

item.title: BLD turf work done; other upgrades pending
item.description: Unrivaled Sports — the firm that took over the Big League Dreams sports complex a year ago this month — has completed the replacement of turf on all six fields.

item.title: The flap over the planning appointment
item.description: First, the correction. Pia Sok was appointed as the Manteca Planning Commission alternate by the Manteca City Council last week. It was not Jesus Sillas as reported in the Bulletin on Tuesday.

item.title: THE ‘HYBRIDS’: MANTECA HOMES, RIPON SCHOOLS
item.description: Count Councilwoman Regina Lackey among those she calls the Manteca “hybrids.” It has nothing to do with the car she drives.
